author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Avoid the risk adverse
    and their curse to
try and coerce
       order from
the babel
instead    dabble
with the           rabble
that transverse
       our blue gem
with methodical
     mayhem
chasing reptilian
delights in the brain stem
vaudevillian
nights, fights, and lights
order undone
          We need the Gonzos,
Pranksters, Jugalos,
     artists, misfits,
and freaks
     Yes even    the      Bronies
rather tham meak phony
peace
seek those who search
their bliss
         on the kiss of chaos
